basic_info.description: Welcome to 2228 45th Avenue - A Charming Outer Parkside Gem!  Nestled in one of San Francisco's most beloved neighborhoods, this beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2-bath home offers 1,364 square feet of comfortable living space with the perfect blend of coastal charm and modern updates. This  detached residence features a brand new roof installed in March 2025, a one-car garage, and a bright, airy layout ideal for modern living.    Located just blocks from Ocean Beach, SF Zoo, and the vibrant Noriega and Taraval corridors, enjoy easy access to neighborhood cafes, restaurants, public transit, and top-rated schools. Whether you're a first-time homebuyer, growing family, or savvy investor, this home offers incredible value in a peaceful, community-oriented setting.  Don't miss the opportunity to live in the desirable Outer Parksidewhere beachside living meets city convenience!
